comment: Variation of levtele-name-unplaced-fort-ludios with another role and seed, and the "<branch> to Xyzzy" spelling: dungeon.c lev_by_name() strips "the ", find_branch("Portal to Fort Ludios") matches no dungeon name, and the retry with the text after " to " matches the unplaced Fort Ludios branch in mixed case (strcmpi), whose end1 ledger_no() reads the zeroed svd.dungeons[n_dgns].
